$description: NEXUS-AI semantic colour + elevation tokens, DARK mode (the product default, docs/03). Every text token passes WCAG 2.1 4.5:1 on all three dark surfaces; every graphical token passes 3:1. Verified by design/test_tokens.py — the matrix is evidence, not intent.

muted.$description: 5.60 / 5.10 / 4.55. Stage 2 step; docs/03 #5C6B82 fails (3.55) — proposal P-2, not applied to docs/03.

strong.$description: Component boundaries (inputs, focusable cards): 4.13 / 3.75 / 3.37 — passes 3:1 on all dark surfaces.

focus.$description: 2px outline. Monochrome on purpose: the accent is brand voice, not interaction state (D-031).

accent.$description: GRAPHICS ONLY (4.16 vs Ink, 3.91 vs Platinum — passes 3:1 graphical, fails 4.5:1 text, therefore never text). Node, wordmark AI, brand lockups.

subtle.$description: 12% of green.400 over panel (badge ground); text-on-tint 6.2+.

text.$description: 7.33 / 6.68 / 5.96. docs/03 #E74C3C fails 4.09 on elevated as text — proposal P-4; kept as graphic step.
5.99 / 5.46 / 4.87. docs/03 #9B59B6 fails as text (4.12) — proposal P-3; kept as graphic step.

graphic.$description: docs/03 --purple verbatim; 3:1 graphical on canvas/panel, 3.35 on elevated.

3.$description: Dark UI elevates mostly by surface step (canvas→panel→elevated); shadows are reinforcement, never the sole elevation cue.
